column1: # PRISM V14 Batch 7R commit allowlist (REL-01). Read by maintenance/release/commit-gate.cjs; never use `git add -A`.
# Every line pins one file to a git blob id: the 513 files of the independent review package (source/ and the
# sanitized reports/) as reviewed, or as changed by the independent-review corrections (see
# PRISM_V14_7R_REVIEW_CORRECTIONS/PRISM_V14_7R_REVIEW_CORRECTIONS_REPORT.md), plus the files that pass added. Lines with original=<blob id> are
# reports whose local original is unredacted: only the sanitized blob may be committed.
# Anything not listed (screenshots, PDFs, logs, cleanup and production-derived evidence) stays local and untracked.
# To change a reviewed file deliberately, update its line with: git hash-object --path=<path> <path>
# Final security hardening pass (PRISM_V14_7R_FINAL_CORRECTIONS): re-pinned the four files it changed and added its report and evidence.
# REL-02 fix (prepare-sanitized private folder): re-pinned commit-gate.cjs, its test and 12 §3, and added the test evidence.
